'''Gy'lan''' was a type of [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. Early in their [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] careers, [[Talon Karrde]] and [[Ellor]] were transporting a load of Gy'lan spice when an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor]] attempted to intercept them. Karrde piloted their [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] in a series of evasive maneuvers and managed to escape by initiating a [[Precision hyperspace jump|microjump]] into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="TLCSB" />
